rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a partnership or collaborative association between people or organizations.

example.english: The partnership between several organizations made this community event a success.
example.traditional: 幾間機構合作搞呢個社區活動，搞得幾成功。
example.jyutping: gei2 gaan1 gei1 gau3 hap6 zok3 gaau2 ni1 go3 se5 keoi1 wut6 dung6 gaau2 dak1 gei2 sing4 gung1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a business partnership in which two or more people run a business together.

example.english: I went into a partnership with Ming to open a café.
example.traditional: 我同阿明合夥開咗間咖啡店。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 aa3 ming4 hap6 fo2 hoi1 zo2 gaan1 gaa3 fe1 dim3
